verdict.rationale: Logseq's docs show the core linking primitives that build a knowledge graph — page/block references ([[]], (())) and simple queries to surface relevant notes — which support exploring connections and filtering to specific topics, but the evidence pack never explicitly documents an interactive graph-visualization view or advanced filtering UI beyond basic queries. missing for 10: explicit documentation of the visual graph view feature, filtering/search controls within that graph UI, and independent hands-on confirmation that graph exploration works well at scale (community notes cite performance/lag issues with larger graphs).
